interaction: Hover or focus a row of the text-only project index and an abstract black/white/grey architectural study (planes, stairs, light shafts, batten screens) follows the cursor; select a row to open a grid-aligned detail panel with a larger study and a 100–120 word project story (arrow keys step through projects); on phones rows expand inline. A 'Show grid' toggle (or the G key) overlays the page's real 12-column grid in red.
